title: Unit Event — Walk on and on — Episode2 An Incomplete Track

meta.Event Outline: In preparation for their next event, Vivid BAD SQUAD, Arata and the others set out to write different songs based on a single theme. Akito and An take on the duty of making the new track, but Toya wishes that he could contribute to lighten their load.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, I think we have a decent idea of what kinds of songs we want to write for this.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm gonna come up with something awesome!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, we'll all be looking forward to hearing it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You seem pretty calm...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. But I'm also looking forward to hearing what your song will be like.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Same with me. Tono, your songs are usually very easy to get into and your performances are usually a cut above the rest of ours.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I really appreciate you saying that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: When did you start writing your own songs, Tono?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
When...? About four or five years ago...
But I started taking it seriously around three years ago when I was in the States.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: As in America...?!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Whoa! That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Thank you, but I didn't do anything special, really. I simply got to listen to a lot of good tracks while I was there, and I was greatly influenced by them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Good tracks...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Um, Tono... What do you believe to be the most ideal track?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Well...
I've been moved by many of them...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But I believe it's one that makes me think, “I couldn't put on a performance this good without this track,” while I'm singing it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It has to be that particular one?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, how should I put it...? A song that not only moves the listener's heart, but also the performer's.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
A song that compels me to sing it.
A song that makes me believe that it's the one.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You've got me curious if you're willing to say that much. What was that song called?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: It doesn't have a title. It isn't available for others to hear either.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Maybe it's better for you all to just hear it...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Here, it's this song...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (What is this? It's like... It's grabbed hold of my heart...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It's so liberating. Like I'm running free. But I also feel this kindness within the turbulence.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(It's an incredible song...
If I could somehow write a song like this...)
se_event_walk_2022_004

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Amazing, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Um, Tono... That song sounded like ended partway through...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, that's because it's still unfortunately incomplete.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Who wrote it?
It almost sounded professional.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: My partner.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Soma...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Which is why it's still incomplete...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
But it's good, no?
I'm glad I got to share it with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(It really was good...
I didn't realize Soma was capable of writing something like this...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Man, I'm beat!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You have been singing pretty hard since the morning, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah, I sorta couldn't help it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But this is no time for me to be saying that I'm tired, since I wanna give our next event everything I have!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And we'll need to start coming up with ideas for our next song.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right. I'll let you know if any good ideas come to mind.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thanks, you two...!
I can't wait to hear what you come up with!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Whoa, it's already this late.
I've gotta get to work soon.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I forgot that I need to help my dad out!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, we did practice for a pretty long time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. As much as I want to come up with ideas for our new song, it's gonna have to wait until I'm done closing up shop.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I'll try giving it some thought on my way home from work.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... Is there any way for me to help...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I don't know how to write songs or make them sound beautiful like Aoyagi... But I still want to help you guys somehow.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Azusawa...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Don't worry about writing the song.
If anything, we need you to focus on how you're gonna perform.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You've improved a lot since just a little while ago, and now you can sing in a way that blows other people away.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But you still need experience.
In time, as you grow, you'll be able to support us even more.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, you should focus on singing in a way that only you can.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Especially since we're gonna need you there if we really are gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, for now, you can leave the songwriting to us! How does that sound...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, I understand...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you! I promise to do my best!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I don't have time to be feeling lost either...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I need to do everything I can right now.)
song00005_off_s
The next day
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I can't seem to focus...
I should probably take a quick break.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I know there isn't much use in me thinking about it, but I keep going back to what we discussed yesterday...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I still don't know how to compose a song that moves people's hearts. Not only that, we ended up having Akito and Shiraishi write the new one for our next event...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The only thing I'm able to do at this point is to make sure I sing in a way that does their song justice.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Which means, if I want to help them, I'll have to practice even more.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I definitely wasn't expecting the place where I usually practice to be undergoing construction. Practicing somewhere new honestly felt a bit strange.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But it was also a nice change of pace.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Isn't the hospital where Soma's staying just nearby?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Toya, would you mind visiting him again sometime? I'm sure you'll both enjoy talking to each other again.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Soma did say that he wanted to hear more about our next event. I think I'll pay him a visit.
Hospital

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Wow, you're all gonna come up with new songs?! You guys just keep churning out great ideas!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we're trying to create more harmony, so to speak, and will be discussing how to create songs in a way which will help achieve that.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
That sounds awesome!
By the way, what kind of theme did you guys choose?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Silence & Action”.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We thought that if we're going to attempt to surpass RAD WEEKEND, we should sing the way Nagi did then...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We want to sing compelling songs that are able to light a fire inside of everybody's hearts in a split second.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah, I get that. Nagi really was awesome when she sang the first song during RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: The second she began singing, not only did she turn the entire place on its head, she brought everyone together...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hehe. I can tell that witnessing it in person meant quite a lot to you...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Of course!
I'm never gonna forget how amazing that event was!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Which means you guys are probably gonna set everything on fire. Do you know who's gonna make the Vivid BAD SQUAD track?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That will be Akito and Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Wait, Aoyagi, you're not gonna write it? I was convinced that you would since you seem to know a ton about music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Tono said something very similar.
However, I tend to compose based on music theory. As a result, I'm yet to achieve the effects I'm after.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Hang on. Don't tell me that you can put songs together entirely from scratch without any sampling. That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I'm only able to do that because of my classical background. Sampling is unique to street music, and I still haven't been able to grasp all the ins and outs of it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's why I've been putting songs together from scratch, but I'm yet to find a sound that feels satisfying...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I see... Just for reference, Aoyagi, what sort of sound are you after?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hmm... How do I describe it...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Something with a good groove...
Or rather, something powerful that moves the listener's heart...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Hmm... A song with a good groove, power and...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The silence I mentioned before is easy for me to envision in terms of a theme.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd probably try to string together a small number of notes in an elegant manner while keeping in mind the individual characteristics of each instrument being played.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, I'm not sure how I'd go about producing a powerful and riveting sound that suits the latter half of our theme.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I believe we're going to need a lot of that if we're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND. So, my current goal is to get a grasp on how to create that power.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Yeah, I totally get what you mean!
But how do you turn “action” into music?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I think that incomplete track of yours is very close to the right answer...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Wait, mine?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Tono shared it with us while we were discussing how we'll be making our new songs.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Your track sounded very liberating. It felt like I was running free.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
There was kindness there, amid the powerful sound...
I was moved by how it was trying to take the listener by the hand.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I sort of began to admire what you'd made.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Come on, it's not that praiseworthy.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, Tono even said, “It's an astounding track,” and how it compels him to want to sing it.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Arata said that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and it seems to mean quite a lot to him. I'm very glad that I had an opportunity to listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Um, Soma...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How did you go about making that track? Would it be alright if I asked for some advice in terms of writing my own?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Because I...
I want to learn how to write moving songs like that.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Oh, advice about songwriting...?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Sorry, I'm afraid that I can't really help you there. Arata usually did all of the songwriting.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wait, Tono said that you wrote that one...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Actually, we wrote it together...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Even though I like sampling sounds and coming up with fun phrases, I'm not all that good at putting them together and turning them into songs. That's Arata's job.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: So, my songwriting skill set is incomplete. Aoyagi, I'm not sure I can teach you much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
I apologize for asking too much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That's unfortunate. I was sure that I'd be able to help the others if I learned how to achieve such a groove...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Regardless, for the sake of our next event, I need to keep trying.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I have to keep doing everything I can.)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: You really are a hard worker, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Okay, I'm not sure if this is gonna help you, Aoyagi, but I may be able to give you some advice about sampling sounds.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: About sampling...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I have no idea if that's going to help, but if there's even a slight chance that it'll help me get close to my goal...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I would like that very much.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: You don't have to be so formal with me, but okay.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
But it's also getting pretty late.
Mind if we pick this up another time?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...
I'm sorry for taking up so much of your time.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Don't worry about that.
I'll be ready to teach you whenever, so stop by again when you're free, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
Then, I'll visit again after practice.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Sure thing. I'll be waiting.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I really didn't expect to offer him sampling lessons...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: But teaching Aoyagi could help me learn to support Arata better...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Which means I also gotta do what I can right now.
